stages.title: Planning & Requirements
stages.next: Write the outcome, who it is for, and what you are not building.

items.label: The outcome is written down
The people who use it are named
What is out of scope is named

stages.title: Local Development (Cursor / IDE)
stages.next: Run the change on this machine and click through the path you care about.

items.label: The app runs locally
The main path has been clicked through

stages.title: Version Control (Git + GitHub)
stages.next: Commit the work and push it to GitHub.

items.label: This folder is a git repository
A remote is configured
The branch is pushed

stages.title: Backend & Database
stages.next: Decide where data lives and check that the project actually contains that setup.

items.label: The data store is chosen and written down
A backend config is in the repo

stages.title: Authentication & Security
stages.next: Name who can sign in, and keep secrets out of the repo.

items.label: Who can sign in is decided
A local secrets file exists (contents are not read)
Secrets are not committed

stages.title: Testing
stages.next: Add a check you can re-run, then run it once for this change.

items.label: The repo has a test setup
Tests were run for this change

stages.title: Deployment
stages.next: Put a deploy config in the repo and deploy once to a non-production URL.

items.label: A deploy config is in the repo
A preview URL was opened

stages.title: Domain & DNS
stages.next: Point the domain at the deployment and open it in a browser.

items.label: DNS points at the host
The public URL loads over HTTPS

stages.title: Monitoring, Analytics & Error Tracking
stages.next: Choose one error tracker and confirm a test event arrives.

items.label: An error tracker or analytics tool is chosen
A test event was received

stages.title: Compliance & Legal
stages.next: Write down the privacy basis, and any agreement a partner still needs.

items.label: Privacy notes (including GDPR, if it applies) are written
Required agreements are identified

stages.title: Soft Launch / Partner Review
stages.next: Send the build to one partner and record what they said.

items.label: A partner has the build
Their feedback is written down
